source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) API Catalogue entry

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Historic England NHLE List Entry 1267530 (Honeylands, Pinhoe Road, Exeter), bound to explicit Honeylands building identity/type-use evidence. The official GOV.UK API Catalogue confirms that NHLE is the official up-to-date register, contains Listed Building points and polygons, uses EPSG:27700, is updated daily, and exposes the Historic England FeatureServer endpoint under the Open Government Licence; however this catalogue window is endpoint/dataset metadata only and exposes no Honeylands record, polygon coordinates, or record-bound geometry. Source-area metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
